No normal-return execution exists with the reserved null page; successful table creation and real buffer-allocation failure remain required.

Source-reviewed malformed count=-1 wrap arm resets manager list/count/capacity to zero and then unconditionally stores table at list + old_count*4 at 0x4c74d6, namely unmapped 0xfffffffc. notes: Boundary-reviewed eighteen-function menu paper batch from the hash-pinned original. All entries are thiscall; 0x48f740 has five stack words despite incomplete decompilation, and its 0x4ec9c0 call has three. Original 0x4ec050 remains owned by player_fade. Exact CRT x87 boundaries retain original conversion and acos; owned sine remains a numerical verification obligation. See ignored packet notes. The successful startup profile also requires reviewed thiscall1/u32 surface attachment 0x4d4100, bringing this closed positive graph to nineteen entries.
